description: Eight tool-heavy questions in one session — designed to accumulate enough tool-result payload (large JSON from search_software, get_allocation_statistics, list_all_software, search_events, etc.) to exercise SummarizationMiddleware once it crosses the configured token threshold. Includes a follow-up turn (turn 7) that intentionally references an earlier resource to test whether the agent can still answer correctly after compaction.

questions.question: Which ACCESS resources have PyTorch installed, and what versions are available on each?
What are the most common allocation types and fields of science in current ACCESS projects?
What ACCESS training events and webinars are coming up in the next month?
Are any ACCESS resources currently in maintenance or experiencing outages?
Find ACCESS affinity groups about AI and machine learning.
What software is installed on Anvil? Give me a comprehensive list.
How does that compare to Delta? What software does Delta have that Anvil doesn't?
Find ACCESS allocations related to climate modeling or atmospheric science.
